'''Lei Muoroy''' was a young [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and posed as a member of [[Bandin Dobah]]'s gang of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].
